answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed marble quarry apprenticeship. The holder carves one numbered marble block under a master mason who inspects a single apprentice per day, tempering chisels in an ember-hot forge and finishing the stone with walnut oil. Random live checks summon the holder to carve that exact block on camera within hours, and one mason cannot work two quarries. The quarry fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another block, another season of stonework, another human, and twice the prior fee.
